plain: John Blitch, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a scientist for DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, who says he was taken by a non-human being, describes a night in 2013 in Fort Collins, Colorado. He says he was expecting a visit, and in the morning he woke to find three bruises on his arm. He tells it as a sign that the visit he expected really happened.
